method: Sorted recursive *.lean files under each named directory. Physical lines = len(bytes.splitlines()), including comments, blank lines, controls and Audit.lean. Aggregator siblings outside the directories excluded. Manifest SHA-256 hashes concatenated relative path + NUL + file-content SHA-256 + newline. History uses git log --reverse --format=%H%x09%cI%x09%s BASE -- PATH (not --follow).
limitations: Physical lines are not theorem counts or minimal proof size.
Path history does not follow predecessor names or measure active work.
Working-tree snapshot includes unpublished files; its hashes, not future live counts, define this measurement.
Scopes overlap neither one another nor include dependencies/scripts/docs.
